wireContract: Preserves client140 and adds the owner-only Telegram Study enablement command and bounded catalogue read. Telegram integration responses add study_enabled, reflecting current-bot owner intent. Catalogue reads distinguish runtime unavailable from available empty and expose only eligible ready songs with bounded keyset pagination. No owner policy-approval or reward endpoint is added.

validation.status: Source candidate. Focused unit, type/Effect and actual PostgreSQL serving-role tests run locally; complete repository checks, exact-commit independent review and hosted checks remain required.
validation.operationalBoundary: Default-off community practice; staging pilot fence retained. The unseeded learner decision mechanism accepts no real policy or song. No runtime, credentials, deployment, grants, production activation or financial operation.
